title: New, renew or correct training record
purpose: Append training or a demonstration of capability while preserving earlier entries.

sections.title: Training access
paragraphs: Admin, reviewer, approver and project manager roles can read all staff training and evidence. Custodian and analyst roles see only their own, including when guessing a record/download link. Only admin and reviewer roles can create, renew or correct training. Staff and reviewer selectors contain active non-client accounts ordered by username, showing full name and username where available.

sections.title: Variants
paragraphs: New training record uses Create training record. A staff query from another page can preselect Staff member. Renew record preloads person, type, title, method, matrix, scope and reviewer; person, type and method are fixed, and new dates/outcome/reference/notes/evidence must be supplied as appropriate. Correct record also preloads original dates, outcome, reference and notes, fixes person/type/method and requires Correction reason. Earlier evidence is not automatically copied. A record already corrected redirects with an error; correct the newer record.

items.label: Staff member
items.description: Required active non-client account; fixed during renewal/correction.

items.label: Type
items.description: Required: Training, Initial demonstration of capability or Ongoing demonstration of capability; fixed during renewal/correction. New forms initially show Training.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required topic/SOP/demonstration, maximum 200 characters.

items.label: Method
items.description: Optional for Training, required for either demonstration type. Selects an exact method/version. Fixed during renewal/correction; choices include inactive methods.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Optional Not specific, Water, Wastewater or Soil.

items.label: Scope
items.description: Optional analytes, techniques or limits of what was shown.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Required Acceptable or Not acceptable. New and renewal forms initially show Acceptable.

items.label: Completed on
items.description: Required, cannot be future.

items.label: Effective on
items.description: Required, on or after completion. May be future, yielding Not yet effective.

items.label: Expires on
items.description: Optional lab-set date strictly after effective date; blank means no expiry. No interval is suggested.

items.label: Reviewed by
items.description: Required active non-client account different from the trainee. No particular reviewer application role is required for the selected person.

items.label: Reviewed on
items.description: Required, defaults to today for new/renewed records, on or after completion and not future.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Optional training sheet, DOC dataset or SOP identifier, maximum 160 characters.

items.label: Evidence file
items.description: Optional validated attachment for this new entry.

items.label: Notes
items.description: Optional supplemental text.

items.label: Correction reason
items.description: Correction only; required reason retained on the new entry and in history.

sections.title: Save and limits
paragraphs: Creates a new immutable record, then opens its detail page. Renewal must retain person, type and exact method version. There is no automatic renewal interval or requirement that a renewal start after the prior record expires. Multiple renewals are possible. A record that has already been corrected cannot be renewed: renew the corrected record instead. A correction of a renewal keeps the renewal link, so the record it renewed still counts as renewed. Correction checks under a lock that no other correction already replaced the original. Neither recording nor renewal grants roles or release permissions.

sections.title: Evidence files
paragraphs: Attach a nonempty PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV no larger than 10 MiB. TXT/CSV must be UTF-8; PDF and image bytes must match the extension. Evidence is optional unless a step requires a reference or file. Downloads are attachments, not inline previews. File links show name, size and the first 12 SHA-256 checksum characters. No file indicates no stored attachment. Staff can download equipment/nonconformance evidence; training evidence is limited to the person and lead roles. A correction is a new record: an earlier attachment is not copied automatically, so attach evidence again if it belongs on the new record.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: An asterisk marks required fields. Cancel returns to the parent record or list without saving. Success opens the saved record with a confirmation. Validation errors appear above the form and beside affected fields; correct them and submit again. Text input remains after validation errors; select an evidence file again if necessary. Dates use year-month-day; date and time fields use the deployment time zone.

sections.title: Form dialog controls
paragraphs: With enhancement enabled, the form opens in a dialog, including when its URL is opened directly. Without enhancement it remains a normal page. While loading or saving, controls are disabled to avoid duplicate submissions; focus moves to the first invalid field or first editable field when ready. Saving successfully navigates to the resulting record.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: Expand the dialog to full screen or restore its normal size. Small screens use a full-screen layout.

items.label: Cancel / Close form / Escape
items.description: Close an unchanged form. When opened over another page, return focus to its opening control; when opened directly, return to the Cancel destination. Clicking outside the dialog does not close it.

items.label: Keep editing / Discard changes
items.description: After an input change, attempting to leave asks Discard your unsaved changes? Keep editing retains the form; Discard changes closes or follows the requested destination without saving. Escape during that prompt keeps editing.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Shown after a failed initial load. Retry loading the form. Save/connection errors keep the current input and show an error so you can retry the submission. Validation errors replace the form with its submitted values and field messages; files may need selecting again.
